Drop participants and record why

Source: R/rawdata-provenance.R
record_exclusion.Rd

This function is the one and only sanctioned way to exclude a participant from a CATLAS raw-data bundle. It removes the identifiers from all three components and appends the rule to provenance(x)$exclusions, so the object can always answer who was removed and why.

Usage

record_exclusion(x, rule, description, ids)

Arguments

x

A catlas_rawdata object.

rule

Character(1). Short machine-friendly rule name, e.g. "incomplete_learning".

description

Character(1). The rule in pre-registrable language.

ids

Character. Identifiers to remove. May be empty, in which case the rule is still recorded.

Value

x with the identifiers removed and the rule appended.

Details

Write description concrete

description is written in such a way that it can be pasted into a pre-registration verbatim. Consequently, provide clear thresholds, not vague adjectives. For instance, do not write "excluded for inattention" but "fewere than 200 experiment trials recorded".

provenance()
